description: `jev-latest` is the alias TypeSafe's own client SDKs send when a caller names no model. As of the 2026-10-26 check it resolves upstream to `jev-1.14.0` (Jev 1.14, released 2026-10-14); the catalog publishes it as its own entry so an SDK-default request resolves to a price instead of answering 502 for a name the catalog does not carry. The alias moves when TypeSafe ships a release, so its answers can change without a change on this side; a workload that has tuned confidence thresholds should pin a versioned ID instead. TypeSafe also documents a `jev-preview` alias, which currently resolves to the same version as `jev-latest`; it is left unpublished so traffic stays on a stable release.
